title: Optional authored viewing-plan v1
description: Separate from the closed presentation and curation profiles. References existing placements and authored presentation viewpoints. Runtime safety/readiness is independently rechecked; orbit limits are metadata, not safe-arc certification. Maximum serialized UTF8 size32768 bytes. Missing or empty plan retains legacy free viewing/list order.

orbit.description: Sculptures only. minYaw<maxYaw, relative radians around authored world-space target; initial angle0, radius/eye height/FOV derive from the authored viewpoint after room-to-world projection.
